properties.evidence: The shape question grew into this capability, built 2026-09-13 as `/g/<graph_id>/`. It weighed (a) edit .mcp.json and reconnect against (b) a graph reference carried per call, and what shipped is (b) in its safest form — carried in the URL path, never defaulted. Both blockers it named are gone: the discovery half was settled separately as dec:describe-a-design-without-binding-to-it and `describe_at` exists, and the store-lock complication is handled by the registry opening on demand. Its own stated rule that should survive either choice — 'default when exactly one design is reachable; refuse and list them when several are' — is what the router does. The capability's description already said it 'Contributes an answer to' this decision, in PROSE, where no query could read it.
